rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a person who tells stories.

example.english: The narrator tells the story so vividly that all the children are completely absorbed.
example.traditional: 嗰個講故事嘅人講得好生動，小朋友個個都聽到入晒神。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gong2 gu2 si6 ge3 jan4 gong2 dak1 hou2 sang1 dung6 siu2 pang4 jau5 go3 go3 dou1 teng1 dou3 jap6 saai3 san4

rows.note: Use this for the narrating voice or voice-over in a film or documentary, including the person understood through that voice.

example.english: The narrator provides the voice-over for this documentary.
example.traditional: 呢套紀錄片嘅旁白由佢負責。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 ge3 pong4 baak6 jau4 keoi5 fu6 zaak3

rows.note: Use this written, literary term when focusing on the person or narrative voice whose viewpoint tells the story.

example.english: The narrator of this novel tells the whole story in the first person.
example.traditional: 呢部小說嘅敘事者以第一身講述成個故事。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 siu2 syut3 ge3 zeoi6 si6 ze2 ji5 dai6 jat1 san1 gong2 seot6 sing4 go3 gu3 si6
